verdict:
WATCH - no position, no bid before 2026-08-21, and a corrected, conditioned price gate at about $136. Both headline kills in this file failed audit, and what is actually wrong with the name is a third thing neither bench led with.

WHAT FAILED. The triage's kill was that the drawdown had been erased by index flow - it has not: the screen premise is intact at roughly -41% from the high, and what is exhausted is the ENTRY, not the premise, since the stock is ~38-42% off its low. Red's kill was the licensing cliff, and it is a disclosure-scope artifact confirmed at the primary. That leaves the real problems, all of which survive: a forward effective tax rate stepping from 1.55% to roughly 23% (about $180M a year of actual cash, and the valuation-allowance release that precedes it will manufacture a one-time GAAP EPS blowout with zero cash content); an advertising line - 94.7% of revenue - lapping roughly 78% growth comps with a fifteen-point sequential deceleration already inside the guide, on which the mandatory seasonality check never ran because desk/seasonality.py was permission-denied to both benches; and an undated, genuinely two-sided Google renewal.

THE DOGFOOD ANGLE, WHICH IS THE PART ONLY WE CAN SEE. This desk consumes Reddit as data: the reddit_mentions detector treats absence as observation, and WSB sentiment feeds the social-thesis engine. We also experienced the moderation and spam machinery firsthand as a publisher. That gives us a real, non-management evidence plane on precisely the leg the market is arguing about - what Reddit's corpus is worth to a licensee and how aggressively Reddit is willing to restrict access. Note the direction of the 7/23 reporting: it is REDDIT weighing restrictions on Google's access, which is a posture consistent with pricing power, not distress. Red priced a stalled negotiation as a cliff; the honest handling is a documentary gate rather than a haircut. And per the 2026-08-18 rule on moat refutation: the proliferation of alternative training corpora falsifies a scarcity premise but says nothing bad about the business - the test is the PRICE per renewal, not the count of substitutes. Until a renewal price prints, 'more data sources exist' is not a bear case.

WHERE OUR OWN BENCHES ERRED ON DOCTRINE. Both counted the street instead of using it. Thirty-three analysts and a $215.63 consensus price target appear in both artifacts; CROWDED was invoked to justify the flow gate (correct - mandatory index flow is a timing instrument) and to deny the orphan carve-out and the conservative-fair-value bias correction (also correct - that carve-out is explicitly the narrow case). But nobody extracted the street's LOAD-BEARING number: what does consensus model for Q3 revenue and adjusted EBITDA against the guide of $860-870M and $385-395M, and where do we differ and why? Our gate is $136 against a street target of $215.63 - a 37% divergence with no stated mechanism, which under anchor-and-adjust doctrine is narrative, not edge. That extraction is now a pre-bid gate. The good news is the one the doctrine emphasises: because this name is heavily covered, our number is gradeable against a published external anchor rather than against ourselves.

THE INDEX EVENT IS ALREADY DECAYING. Inclusion was announced 8/14 and the tape ran $158.12 to $178.09 (+12.6%) on the announcement, then gave back to the $164-169 area BEFORE the 8/18 effective date - the classic announcement-effect front-run and effective-date give-back. So the no-bid rationale is weaker than red implied, but the measurement windows both benches set (the 8/21 and 8/28 closes) become more informative, not less. Hold the no-bid window through 8/21 and measure.

GATE ARITHMETIC AND ITS CONDITION. Thirty times 2026 estimated free cash flow less stock compensation of about $780M gives an enterprise value of $23.4B; add $2.79B of net cash and divide by the 192.4M shares I verified on the cover page: about $136. That is a valuation finding, so a price gate is the correct instrument under the response taxonomy. But it must be conditioned, because RDDT at $136 will most plausibly arrive either through a growth-complex drawdown or through an advertising miss - the second of which makes the thesis worse rather than cheaper. So: $136 is a re-court trigger, and it converts to a bid only with the licensing documentary gate satisfied and advertising growth tracking the guide. The existing ledger alert at $119.27 (the 52-week low) stays as review-only.

WHAT IS GENUINELY GOOD HERE, STATED PLAINLY. Six-month stock compensation fell 3% while revenue grew 61%, taking SBC from 34.9% of revenue to 21.0%; $239.6M of buybacks were paid in cash over six months against a $1.0B authorisation; cash and marketable securities are $2.786B against $20.9M of lease debt; six-month operating cash flow was $574.1M against $2.2M of capital expenditure. That is an honest filer with real money, and it is why this is a WATCH with a gate rather than an AVOID.
blue_ruling: PARTIALLY OVERTURNED - blue sustained red's arithmetic audits (share base, tax rate, SBC exoneration, the intact drawdown) and overturned red's strongest kill on a scope argument that I re-fetched and confirmed. Red's finding 1 was that the 10-Q's remaining-performance-obligation schedule shows only $30.1M of licensing revenue contracted into 2027 against a $172M annualised run-rate, an '82% coverage gap' it graded near-FATAL to the terminal-value leg. Per BLUE-CORRECTIONS-AUDITED I pulled the 10-Q directly with desk/sec_fetch.py (no proxy) and the note reads: 'As of June 30, 2026, the aggregate amount of remaining performance obligations in contracts with an original expected duration exceeding one year was $92.1 million. This amount consists primarily of long-term content licensing contracts and excludes deferred revenue related to short-term advertising contracts and Reddit Premium subscriptions. We expect to recognize $62.0 million in the remainder of 2026 and $30.1 million in 2027.' The scope carve-out is in the sentence red quoted: ASC 606 RPO excludes contracts whose original expected duration is one year or less, so an annually-renewing licensing book will ALWAYS show a collapsing forward RPO. The $30.1M measures contract tenor, not renewal probability. Blue's overturn PASSES. I also re-verified the cover page: 146,103,200 Class A plus 46,293,310 Class B, so 192,396,510 shares outstanding at 2026-07-29 - which makes blue's gate arithmetic right and red's wrong: red divided by the brief's 202.3M diluted-weighted count while simultaneously arguing the correct base is 192.4M, so its $130 gate is self-inconsistent and the correct figure is ~$136.
reopen_gates: HARD DOCUMENTARY GATE, PRE-BID (retained from both benches): an 8-K or company PR naming the Google agreement as renewed with term and annual value, OR the next 10-Q's RPO table showing 2027 committed licensing revenue above $100M. Until one of these exists, the licensing leg is an undated binary with an unquantified sign - which the response taxonomy answers with a gate, not a size haircut.

PRICE, CONDITIONED (corrected to ~$136 from red's self-inconsistent $130 and the brief's $145): 30x 2026E FCF-minus-SBC of ~$780M plus $2.79B net cash divided by 192,396,510 shares outstanding (adjudicator-verified on the 10-Q cover). ACTIONABLE only if the documentary gate above is satisfied AND Q3 advertising revenue is tracking the $860-870M guide. Unconditioned, this level fires on a growth-complex drawdown or an ads miss - both of which are the thesis getting worse. The existing ledger alert at $119.27 stays REVIEW-ONLY.

FLOW: no bid before 2026-08-21. Measure index-flow decay at the 8/21 and 8/28 closes against the $178.09 announcement pop and the pre-announcement $158.12. The mandatory bid was largely front-run before the 8/18 effective date, so the measurement - not the calendar - decides when the flow gate lifts.

PRINT (~2026-10-29, yfinance-derived UNCONFIRMED - no company PR or 8-K names it): US daily-unique growth at or above 6% and ACCELERATING (not merely holding), Other revenue above +24%, and advertising against the guide with the comp base stated. Note the comp problem explicitly: advertising +64% laps a Q2'25 that itself grew ~78%, so the comps harden every quarter through the guide.

DIVERGENCE (owed before any bid, per DIVERGENCE-NOT-COVERAGE): extract street consensus Q3 revenue and adjusted EBITDA against the company's $860-870M / $385-395M guide, plus the dispersion, and state our number beside it with the mechanism. Our $136 gate against a $215.63 consensus target is a 37% gap with no stated cause - and a price target is the weakest form of the street's view.

DATA (infra, owed): app_review_velocity for RDDT and the PINS control both failed pre-flight with 'TypeError: _ok() got an unexpected keyword argument raw_response_snippet' - twice, in two benches. Per infra-masquerading-as-negative doctrine this is a runner defect that must be fixed and re-run; it is the only independent dated read on US engagement before the print. Likewise desk/seasonality.py was permission-denied to both benches and the mandatory deceleration check on the advertising line has never run.

DOGFOOD WATCH (new, and the piece only this desk can instrument): stand up a standing watch on Reddit's data-access and API/licensing terms as we experience them - rate limits, corpus availability, terms changes, and any restriction actually imposed on a named licensee. We consume this corpus, so a change in access policy is a first-hand read on renewal pricing power that reaches us before it reaches the tape.
process_findings: DOGFOOD NAME: the desk consumes Reddit as data (reddit_mentions absence-is-observation; WSB sentiment for the social-thesis engine) and has firsthand experience of its moderation and spam machinery as a publisher. That is a genuine non-management evidence plane on the exact leg under dispute, and this draft wires it as a standing watch rather than leaving it as context. Conflict noted: we are a customer of the product we are valuing, and our experience is a sample of one.

BLUE-CORRECTIONS-AUDITED: PASSES. I re-fetched the 10-Q direct with desk/sec_fetch.py and confirmed the RPO scope sentence verbatim ('original expected duration exceeding one year'; $92.1M / $62.0M / $30.1M) and the cover-page share counts (146,103,200 + 46,293,310 = 192,396,510). Blue's scope overturn and its gate correction to ~$136 both stand; red's $130 was self-inconsistent (it divided by 202.3M diluted-weighted while arguing the base is 192.4M).

DIVERGENCE-NOT-COVERAGE: no kill rested on coverage - CROWDED was used for the flow gate (correct, mandatory index flow is a timing instrument) and to deny the orphan carve-out (correct, that carve-out is the narrow case). The violation is by omission: 33 analysts and a $215.63 target were counted and no consensus revenue or EBITDA was ever extracted, so our $136 gate stands 37% below the street's anchor with no stated mechanism. Extraction is now a pre-bid gate.

MOAT-REFUTATION CHECK (2026-08-18): the proliferation of alternative training corpora refutes a data-scarcity premise but is not itself a bear case. The test is the renewal PRICE per contract, not the count of substitutes - and the direction of the reporting is that Reddit is the party threatening restriction, which is a pricing-power posture. No sign may be assigned to the Google renewal until terms print.

HELD STATUS: NOT HELD. Ledger row exists (REJECT / WATCH, stage COURTED_CQ0804, alert_below 119.27, band 128-140 proposed in two tranches, none staged). This draft supersedes that band with the single conditioned gate at ~$136 and keeps 119.27 as review-only. No order is staged and none may be before 2026-08-21.

PRINT CLOCK AND FLOW CLOCK: the S&P 500 inclusion was effective pre-open 2026-08-18 - that is TOMORROW relative to the court date and TODAY relative to this adjudication; the no-bid window runs through 2026-08-21 and the measurement closes are 8/21 and 8/28. The next print is ~2026-10-29 (UNCONFIRMED), roughly 50 trading days out. No print-race discipline triggered.

INFRA DEFECT (twice, two benches): app_review_velocity failed pre-flight with a TypeError on both the RDDT and PINS control runs. Per the infra-masquerading-as-negative doctrine this must alert as a runner defect, not pass as a null - and it removes the only independent dated engagement read before the print. desk/seasonality.py was also permission-denied to both benches, so the mandatory deceleration check on the advertising line has never run on this name.

TAPE DISCIPLINE: red used $169.12 and blue used the pack's $164.42 - two different anchors in one court, with IBKR permission-denied to both. Any gate must be re-priced on a live quote before it is treated as fillable.

TAX: no dividend, so no distribution carry. The tax finding here is the issuer's own: a forward effective-rate step from 1.55% to roughly 23% is about $180M a year of real cash and belongs in the fair value; the valuation-allowance release that precedes it is non-cash and must not be read as earnings.

ANTI-MASKING FINDING (positive, worth recording): six-month SBC fell 3% to $169.3M while revenue grew 61%, taking SBC from 34.9% to 21.0% of revenue, with $239.6M of buybacks paid in cash. The absence of masking is itself a finding and it is why this name stays on the sheet.

kg_candidates.source: blue bench (RDDT); adjudicator re-fetched the 10-Q direct and confirms the scope sentence verbatim
kg_candidates.disposition: ACCEPT - and it must be wired as a GUARD in front of rpo_drift, which fired here and produced a near-FATAL verdict on an expected null. Sibling of the LEU backlog guard from the same batch: two separate courts this week reached masking verdicts against disclosure rules the filings state in plain sentences.
kg_candidates.one_line: ASC 606 remaining-performance-obligation disclosure excludes contracts with an original expected duration of one year or less, so an annually-renewing licensing or usage book always shows collapsing forward committed revenue - reading that as a demand cliff is a disclosure-scope artifact, not a signal.

kg_candidates.evidence_here: RDDT 10-Q 6/30/26, adjudicator-verified direct from sec.gov: '$92.1 million... in contracts with an original expected duration exceeding one year... $62.0 million in the remainder of 2026 and $30.1 million in 2027', against ~$172M annualised Other revenue. The red bench read an 82% coverage gap as near-FATAL to terminal value; the note excludes annually-renewing AI licensing deals by construction.

kg_candidates.name: valuation_allowance_release_eps_artifact
kg_candidates.source: red bench (RDDT); blue corrected the severity
kg_candidates.disposition: ACCEPT AS AMENDED - blue is right that the release itself is non-cash and does not touch free cash flow, so the finding is not the one-time credit; the finding is the PERMANENT forward ETR step (here 1.55% to roughly 23%, about $180M a year of real cash) plus the screen-hygiene hazard that the release quarter prints as an operating blowout and the following quarter prints as a miss. Harvest with both halves and with the direction that the cash step is the material one.
kg_candidates.one_line: A disclosed-as-imminent deferred-tax valuation-allowance release manufactures a one-time GAAP EPS blowout with zero cash content and then permanently resets the forward effective tax rate upward - screens read the beat as operating leverage and the reset as deterioration, while the cash finding is the reset alone.
kg_candidates.fires_on: a 10-Q/10-K tax note maintaining a full valuation allowance while stating that positive evidence may become available within the next twelve months to release a significant portion, where the current effective tax rate is below ~5% and pretax income is growing
kg_candidates.evidence_here: RDDT 10-Q 6/30/26: full valuation allowance maintained with explicit next-twelve-months release language; Q2'26 tax $3,987K on pretax $256,835K = 1.55% effective rate (the brief said 2.4% on $259.0M pretax - both figures wrong). Both the release and the reset land inside a normal holding period.

kg_candidates.disposition: ACCEPT - the desk's own consumption of an issuer's product is a legitimate, non-management evidence plane, and it is exactly the kind of divergence input a covered name otherwise denies us. It needs to be a wired watch rather than an anecdote, and it needs an explicit conflict note (we are a customer, so our experience is a sample of one).
kg_candidates.one_line: Where the desk itself consumes the issuer's product or data, our own usage telemetry (access terms, rate limits, moderation behaviour, product quality) is a first-hand evidence plane that does not route through management and often leads the disclosed metrics.
kg_candidates.fires_on: a courted issuer whose product or data the desk consumes operationally - stand up a dated watch on the specific access/quality dimension the thesis turns on, and record it as observation, not opinion
kg_candidates.evidence_here: RDDT: the desk runs the reddit_mentions detector (absence-is-observation) and WSB sentiment for the social-thesis engine, and encountered Reddit's moderation/spam machinery as a publisher. The licensing leg the market is arguing about is the leg we validate personally - LLM labs license exactly the corpus we scrape - so access-policy changes reach us before they reach the tape.

packs_to_arm.date_confidence: yfinance-derived, UNCONFIRMED - no company PR or 8-K names it, and it is absent from the filing inventory. Q2 printed 2026-07-30, which supports late October. Re-key on the company PR.
packs_to_arm.adjudication: Read in order, and note that the licensing line is the loudest but the advertising line is 94.7% of the revenue: (1) advertising revenue against the $860-870M guide and against the ~78% prior-year comp - the sequential deceleration already guided is fifteen points, so the question is whether it deepens; (2) US daily uniques against +6%, accelerating rather than merely holding, since the Google-referral tail shows up here first; (3) Other revenue against +24% AND the RPO table's 2027 committed licensing figure against $100M - read them together, since the RPO alone is scope-limited; (4) any 8-K or commentary naming the Google or OpenAI renewals with term and value; (5) the tax line and any valuation-allowance release - separate the one-time non-cash credit from the forward ETR step, which is the real ~$180M/yr; (6) SBC and buyback against $169.3M six-month SBC and $239.6M repurchased, to confirm the honest-filer signature holds.

branches.ADS TRACKING GUIDE + US DAU ACCELERATING: the documentary gate is satisfied and the growth leg is intact; the $136 level converts from a re-court trigger into a live bid, tranched, with the ETR step modelled explicitly.
branches.ADS TRACKING GUIDE BUT LICENSING STILL U: hold WATCH with the hard documentary gate in force - a fair price for the advertising business alone is defensible, but do not pay for the licensing annuity until a renewal price exists.
branches.ADS DECELERATING BEYOND THE GUIDE ON A H: the thesis driver breaks; move toward AVOID and stop treating the drawdown as a dislocation - the comp math means the next two quarters get harder, not easier.
branches.GOOGLE RENEWAL LAPSES OR REDDIT RESTRICT: two-sided event - restriction with a price increase is pricing power confirmed (bullish); lapse with no replacement is roughly $130M of near-100%-margin revenue gone, about 3% of revenue but a larger share of incremental EBITDA. Read the announced TERMS before assigning a sign.
branches.VALUATION-ALLOWANCE RELEASE PRINTS: expect a headline EPS blowout with no cash content followed by a permanently higher ETR; do not let a screen re-rate on it, and re-run the FCF-minus-SBC gate on the post-reset tax rate.

packs_to_arm.date_confidence: DATE-CERTAIN (market calendar) - the 8/21 and 8/28 closes are the index-flow decay measurement windows both benches set; the S&P 500 inclusion was effective pre-open 2026-08-18, which is confirmed by the index announcement of 8/14.
packs_to_arm.adjudication: Purely a measurement pack, no fundamentals: record the closes on 8/21 and 8/28 against the $158.12 pre-announcement price, the $178.09 announcement pop and the ~$164-169 pre-effective level, plus volume against ADV. The question is whether the mandatory bid decayed (already substantially front-run) and whether the give-back overshoots below the pre-announcement level, which would be the first genuinely non-flow-contaminated price on this name since 8/13.

branches.PRICE HOLDS ABOVE THE PRE-ANNOUNCEMENT $: flow decayed cleanly; the no-bid window lifts and the $136 gate is the only remaining price constraint.
branches.PRICE GIVES BACK BELOW $158 ON HEAVY VOL: index buyers are being sold to; wait for the flow to finish and re-measure - do not catch someone else's unwind.
branches.PRICE RE-RATES UP THROUGH $178 WITHOUT N: the flow was larger than modelled; stand aside entirely - the value-ladder gate forbids bidding into flow we predicted, and there is no fundamental catalyst until 10/29.
